The '''Chiss Expansionary Fleet''' was the external defense [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy's]] [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force|Expansionary Defense Fleet]] that was charged with patrol of the Ascendancy's borders.<ref name="TEA" /> The Expansionary Fleet was governed by the [[Expansionary Fleet's charter]] which only permitted observation and exploration in the regions around the Ascendancy. Both the Expansionary Fleet<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> and the [[Chiss Defense Fleet|Defense Fleet]] wore specialized [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Defense Fleet uniform]]s.<ref name="Survivor's Quest">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref> When a [[Chiss warrior/Legends|Chiss warrior]] was accepted into the Expansionary Fleet, they were made a [[Merit adoptive/Legends|merit adoptive]] of a [[Chiss family/Legends|Chiss family]]. Unlike the [[Starship/Legends|starships]] of the Defense Fleet which were equipped with lesser [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitters]] and relied on a colony system's network of boosters and repeaters, the Expansionary Fleet vessels were equipped with more powerful transmitters.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

During the [[Great Galactic War]], the entire [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] acted as an external defense military force, similar to<ref name="CEDF Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Chiss Expansionary Defense Force (Agent)}}</ref> the Expansionary Fleet<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> of [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].<ref name="Outbound Flight Date">{{OutboundFlightDate}}</ref>

{{Chiss-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Chiss Expansionary Fleet first appeared in the [[2006]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']], written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> The [[2004]] novel ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'' erroneously referred to the Chiss Expansionary Fleet as the Chiss Defense Fleet.<ref name="Survivor's Quest" />
